name: claude-tools
description: Skills and hooks for Claude Code: prompting Fable, an image looker, a Fable advisor, a Haiku worker for mechanical jobs, rules for writing clearly and a check for stock AI phrasing.

plugins.name: fable-prompting
plugins.description: Prompting techniques for Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5: effort levels, symptom-to-fix snippets and task scoping.

plugins.name: look
plugins.description: Separate model runs look at screenshots and rate them against your aims, so the agent judges a visual result without reading the image itself.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: A separate read-only Fable run decides a design or implementation question in the person's place and returns one choice with its reason.

plugins.name: haiku-worker
plugins.description: A background Haiku subagent does one mechanical job, such as a search, a test run or an edit to a written spec, and returns only its result, so the main agent keeps its context and every judgment.

plugins.name: write-clearly
plugins.description: Rules for writing, revising and reviewing any text a reader opens cold: define terms, plain headings, ordered decision rules, plain sentences, no marks of generated text, no history, and code comments that explain why.

plugins.name: no-claudisms
plugins.description: Hooks catch stock AI phrasing from the claudisms.ai list in chat replies, reports, markdown files, commits and PR text, hide it on screen and ask the agent to reword it, at no context cost until a phrase is found.
